mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, status, total_amount, address, remark, created_at, paid_at, shipped_at, completed_at, cancelled_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{address}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{paidAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{shippedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{cancelledAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders o LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
